Name: ASSET_MODEL_SFX_PARAM_ST
Description: Effects attached to a placed asset's model. Row ID = asset model number × 1000 + state × 100 + relative ID: state is 0 before and 1 after the asset breaks (likely); the relative ID (0–99) is picked at random from the up-to-4 SFX relative IDs set on the MSB asset part (negative entries skipped). Up to 8 effects per row.

Fields.Name: SFX ID [0]
Fields.Description: Effect 0. Spawned at every dummy poly with Dummy Poly ID [0]. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Dummy Poly ID [0]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly effect 0 attaches to; one effect per matching dummy poly. ≤ 0: effect 0 isn't spawned.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Is Irradiance Volume Disabled
Fields.Description: Sets a flag on every effect this row spawns. The flag's rendering effect isn't traced; the name suggests the effects are left out of irradiance volume capture. Retail never sets it.
